text:
Asha: Quick ask — need a pocket 1-pager for field on private/Dedicated launches. Goal: skimmable, one PDF they can email.

Ben: Love it. Keep four micro-panels: 1) Why it matters (1 line), 2) Security + compliance snapshot, 3) Bench highlight, 4) Sales routing + CTA. Figma starter: https://redwood.app/figma/deploy-kit-pocket

Carlos: Bench owner here. Latest run (2026-03-29): text-gen-2 @512 p95 = 75ms on Dedicated. Median cost per 1k tokens on Dedicated = $0.40. We measured comparative self-host samples at ~$0.68/k. Rough unit-cost delta ~41%. I'll drop csv to Drive.

Marta: Good numbers. Add a one-line engineering note calling out graceful fallback: hosted -> dedicated -> private, plus model-variant fallback. Sales likes explicit routing examples.

Ben: Proposed routing snippet for playbook (pasteable):

```
# inbound-routing example for field
if customer.region == 'EU' and customer.requires_isolation:
    route_to = 'private-vpc-eu'
elif customer.commitment_monthly >= 25000:
    route_to = 'dedicated-reservation'
else:
    route_to = 'hosted-api-standard'
```

Asha: Nice. For the one-pager headline options, let's A/B test: Variant A = "Enterprise-grade SLAs for LLM Serving" vs Variant B = "Private, Predictable Inference for Regulated Apps". Track CTR and gated-download conversion.

Marta: FAQ bullets to include: SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA options, KMS/HSM integrations, audit log retention windows. Also call out token-level cost observability and per-route latency charts.

Carlos: For the webinar/demo (Apr 14 suggested), I'd demo routing + live failover and show the dashboard for per-route latencies. Need ~8 slides + 7-min demo script.

Asha: Deliverables: 1) pocket 1-pager PDF (print + email), 2) 30s social script + hero image, 3) webinar landing copy + gated asset, 4) field playbook with routing snippet. Marcom: can you seed the landing?

MarcomBot: Landing scaffold created: https://redwood.app/landing/deploy-kit. I can schedule announcement for Apr 14 10:00 PT if final assets arrive by Apr 9 EOD.

Ben: Assignments: Asha = copy + design signoff; Carlos = bench csv + slides; Marta = FAQ + field playbook; Ben = headline A/B setup + webinar flow; MarcomBot = landing + scheduling.

Asha: I'll post first PDF draft here by Apr 8 for quick feedback. Thanks :rocket:
